page: Microsoft Azure DC64es_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEV5 server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and an Intel processor. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, providing dedicated CPU allocation for workloads requiring consistent compute resources.

This instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. While the DCEV5 family is designated as memory-optimized, this specific configuration maintains a balanced 1:4 resource ratio. The server does not include local storage, but it is premium storage capable, allowing high-performance external disk attachments. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

Due to the dedicated 64 vCPUs and 256.0 GB RAM, this server is configured for enterprise workloads. It is suitable for relational databases, application servers, and general-purpose enterprise applications that utilize external premium storage.

It contains no onboard GPUs and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With its dedicated CPU allocation and substantial memory capacity, the DC64es_v5 is designed for enterprise applications, database workloads, and general-purpose business systems requiring consistent compute performance and external storage flexibility.
